verdict: Palantir's revenue jumped 36% to $828M as U.S. sales soared 52%, but a one-time $116M stock charge tied to its founders' appreciation rights held GAAP profit to $79M for shareholders.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $0.04 a year ago — held back by the one-time SAR charge

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for governments, above all the U.S. military and intelligence agencies — U.S. government revenue grew 45% YoY to $343M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 64% to $214M as the AIP 'bootcamp' push kept winning customers, and Palantir closed a record $803M of U.S. commercial contract value.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Sales teams and the 'bootcamp' try-before-you-buy push that has been winning commercial customers — this line absorbed much of the one-time SAR stock charge.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platforms — Gotham, Foundry and the AIP AI layer.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company: legal, finance and offices.

otherDetail: Interest income of $55M on Palantir's cash pile, plus $15M of other income — a net +$70M below operating profit.
footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $77M; $79M of it is attributable to common stockholders (noncontrolling interests absorbed a $2M loss). Segment figures are Palantir's FY2024 10-K segment revenue less the nine-month figures in its Q3 2024 10-Q, rounded to the nearest $M; Commercial is shown as $373M so the segments tie to the $828M total.

takeaways.title: U.S. business customers surged
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue grew 64% YoY to $214M, and Palantir closed a record $803M of U.S. commercial contract value — up 134% — as its AIP bootcamps kept converting into deals. It then guided 2025 revenue to grow 31%.

takeaways.title: A one-time stock charge masked profit
takeaways.text: GAAP operating income was just $11M because the quarter absorbed $116M of accelerated stock pay tied to the founders' market-vesting appreciation rights (SARs), plus related payroll taxes. Excluding the SAR items, operating income was $142M and net income $165M.

takeaways.title: Cash generation stayed elite
takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $517M — 63 cents of every revenue dollar — and Palantir ended 2024 with $5.2B of cash and Treasury securities.

oneTimers: One-time SAR-related expenses: $115.8M of accelerated stock-based compensation plus $15.5M of employer payroll taxes, triggered by the vesting of market-vesting stock appreciation rights (SARs). Palantir's own figures excluding them: net income of $165M and EPS of $0.07.
Total stock-based compensation was $282M in the quarter (including the SAR acceleration) — a real cost to shareholders through dilution, even though it is not cash.
